title: The Rock Cycle and Resources
seo_title: Grade 5 Science: The Rock Cycle and Resources Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Earth materials change through the rock cycle and can be used as natural resources: minerals, rock, clay, gravel, sand and soil, and First Peoples sustainable practices around BC's resources. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 5, Earth and Space Science)
meta_desc: Free Grade 5 science worksheets (BC): minerals, igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks, the rock cycle and uses of Earth materials. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Rocks change from one type to another in the rock cycle.
body_html:
How to think about it

Igneous rock forms when magma or lava cools. Sedimentary rock forms when layers of sand, mud and shells are pressed and cemented together. Metamorphic rock forms when heat and pressure change other rocks. In the rock cycle, any rock can become another type.

Rocks are made of minerals, which are identified by colour, streak, lustre and hardness. BC uses many Earth materials: gravel and sand for roads, clay for bricks, and minerals such as copper from mines.

Example

Granite forms from cooled magma. What type of rock is it?

Fire-formed rock

Answer: igneous

Example

Which rock type often contains fossils?

Layers of sediment bury plants and animals.

Answer: sedimentary

Common mistakes

  • Thinking rocks never change.
  • Mixing up minerals and rocks (rocks are made of minerals).
  • Thinking metamorphic rock melts completely.
